Captured from https://deos-tmp-960b90f76572a9ddf32a7297.skundu.workers.dev/?scenario=unlinked&pr=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fsachinkundu%2Fdeos-sample-project%2Fpull%2F46; Chromium inside the implementation sandbox

A checked-account identity mismatch blocks both provider steps before either action starts.
Captured from https://deos-tmp-960b90f76572a9ddf32a7297.skundu.workers.dev/?scenario=identity-guard&pr=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fsachinkundu%2Fdeos-sample-project%2Fpull%2F46; Chromium inside the implementation sandbox

items.title: Settings connects and freezes the one allowed BettaView account
items.reason: The inspected current-tree screenshot shows verified Access, numeric GitHub identity, the selected Linear identity, required states, and the activated checked-account policy.

items.title: Draft notes write nothing to GitHub or Linear and the browser holds no Linear access
items.reason: The inspected review UI exposes only Comment, Approve, and Request changes while both provider steps are not started; passing BettaView tests cover local draft storage and the production-path Showboat confirms provider work begins only after Publish.

items.title: Published REQUEST_CHANGES review moves the task to In Progress and continues the edit path
items.reason: The inspected final application captures show GitHub and Linear complete with the linked workflow continued, including restoration in a fresh browser context. The retained review Showboat records the production continuation call order. Final-tree provider receipts are selected separately as provider-originated proof.

items.title: Approval with inline notes moves the task to Merging and allows only the merge path
items.reason: The screenshot shows GitHub approval and Linear Merging complete; selected provider receipts confirm review 5260494478 retained its notes and signed delivery 857d1577-0f09-4441-b7dd-8762292363fb.

items.title: Approval with no notes also moves the task to Merging
items.reason: The no-notes UI is pixel-identical to the selected approval success image; selected provider proof distinguishes review 5260495532 by its empty body and signed delivery 3926c58f-ae14-4c8c-81fc-d9020da70bb4.

items.title: A rejected GitHub review never moves the task and preserves the original provider error
items.reason: The inspected UI preserves github_rejected, marks GitHub failed retryable, and visibly leaves Linear not started; sequencing and cause preservation are covered by the passing workflow tests.

items.title: A lost GitHub response is reconciled by read-back, and an unprovable read stops for a host check
items.reason: The inspected UI shows host check required with Linear not started and no retry action; passing idempotency tests cover read-back and suppression, while the production-path Showboat demonstrates one permit, one receipt, and one Linear allocation.

items.title: A failed task move keeps the review done, retries only the task move, and a missing signed delivery escalates
items.reason: The retained failure capture shows GitHub remaining done while only Linear is retryable. The inspected current-tree captures show the repaired retry persisted as both steps done in the same and a fresh browser context; Showboat retains the durable provider ordering and no-repeat behavior.

items.title: An old head and an unlinked pull request block host writes while the page stays readable
items.reason: Both inspected states keep the review readable, disable all review decisions, and explain either the stale head or missing open gate.

items.title: A head advance after a GitHub receipt abandons before Linear and the replacement never repeats visible feedback
items.reason: The inspected predecessor is terminal with Linear not started; the separately inspected replacement completes both steps. Passing lineage tests cover non-repetition of visible feedback.

items.title: Forged page identity, a mismatched user ID, a reused review ID and a second intent all fail without any host write
items.reason: The inspected identity mismatch blocks both provider steps before writes; passing service and orchestration tests cover forged identity, review-ID reuse, lease, and second-intent guards.

items.title: An app-originated Linear state event cannot approve the gate and is restored once
items.reason: The inspected gate waits for a checked human review with both provider steps not started; passing transition tests cover rejecting/restoring app-originated state events, and Showboat shows the saved GitHub review—not the app delivery—as the review choice.
